note: A real-click corpus with replay evaluation showing simulator inflation and rank changes is exactly the published RClicks benchmark (NeurIPS 2024). Scooped nearly verbatim. Lit-attacked below.

Time-based comparisons of annotation primitives date to the point-supervision literature (Bearman-era cost accounting) and interface studies since; the shape-conditional map is a refinement, not a discovery.

Structural unreachability (masks no prompt can produce) defines the true expressivity boundary of frozen interactive models - a different object than average benchmarks measure; search-budget honesty is the only methodological demand.

Collection order as a hidden hyperparameter of dataset quality is a fresh claim with a clean simulation design; the real-study anchor is needed because compounding effects are exactly what simulators idealize away.

Correlated (not independent) contamination from verify-workflows breaks the noise assumptions of the entire label-noise literature; the train-on-verified inheritance leg makes it causal. Core of the inbreeding thesis with 0206.

SAM-fingerprint detection plus inheritance measurement is the flagship of the data-genetics agenda: forensic, timely, and consequential for every dataset built since 2023. Mixed-provenance blurring is the technical fight. Lit-attacked below.

Scribble-simulation and placement studies exist across weakly-supervised segmentation; the region-vs-boundary decomposition of placement value is an ablation, and the guided-human confirmation is costly for its payoff.
Region-level AL for segmentation is established; the overhead-aware cost-model twist is real but the field's response will be 'so publish the cost model' - a tool, not a thesis.

A pre-commitment law (measure shape entropy from 20 masks, predict point-supervision viability) is exactly the kind of decision rule annotation planners lack; the context-entropy covariate handles the obvious confound.
Pixel-level expertise-premium mapping is a sensible economics study; requires commissioning dual expert/crowd annotation in two domains, and the routed-dataset validation doubles the bill.
Frame-selection for interactive video annotation is a published genre (frame-recommendation for IVOS); drift-onset timing is a variant gated on the unproven self-diagnosis signal (0047).
The good-enough plateau and dataset-attribution-by-residuals extend 0205/0206 naturally; as a standalone it overlaps them heavily - fold into the inbreeding program as its human-behavior leg.

Gaze-as-weak-supervision for medical segmentation has multiple recent papers (REFLACX-era eye-tracking supervision line); the performance-accounting delta is not enough, and gaze's extent-vs-hotspot limitation is already documented.
Click-vs-language crossover at an instance-density threshold is a well-posed HCI question with a routed-interface payoff; grounding-model quality gates the language arm and dates the result.

'Protocol choice dominates the median architecture improvement' is the most subversive testable claim in C09; commissioning the dual-protocol corpus is expensive but the comparison design is airtight. Protect.

Negative-region annotation economics for the tail is sensible and simulable from existing labels first; the too-easy-negatives failure mode (own note) is exactly what killed naive hard-negative mining, so the guided version carries the burden.

Zoom telemetry as free ambiguity ground truth is genuinely original; requires instrumenting a real annotation pipeline (partnership) and the ergonomics confounds need the regression controls it prescribes.
Wizard-of-Oz before building the question generator is the right derisking order; the claim is plausible for compositional ambiguity specifically, and the object subset where it wins may be narrow.
Correction reuse as an order-of-magnitude lever on homogeneous corpora is a strong bet; silent label corruption from bad transfers (own note) is the catastrophic failure mode and gating is unproven.

The quality-quantity phase boundary (rough masks nearly free for region tasks, worse-than-useless below a precision threshold for boundary tasks) would govern every annotation spec; real dual-quality anchoring is the required honesty.

Multi-view consistency as 2D supervision is heavily adjacent to published NeRF/3D-distillation lines (semantic field consistency, SAM-in-3D); the view-dependent-failure-case framing is the surviving sliver and needs a lit check.

Click order as a cognitive probe of shared human-model difficulty structure is charmingly original; UI/motor confounds (own note) could account for most of the regularity, and the payoff is interpretive rather than actionable.

Three-state labeling with downstream accounting is the applied twin of 0143 (undecidability annotation); keep 0143 as the scientific version and treat this as its deployment study, not a separate bet.

Ecosystem-scale tool forensics merges with 0156 and feeds 0206's provenance program; the weights-probing leg (models encode tool style) is the most novel and least certain part. One forensics paper, not three.

The extreme-budget phase map (paradigm rankings invert; consistency methods collapse below thresholds) directly indicts the field's habit of extrapolating efficiency claims downward; seed-variance demands make it compute-honest but bounded.
